units.source_text: 这一年夏天，小皇子的母亲桐壶更衣觉得身体不好，想乞假回娘家休养，可是皇上总不准许。

en.t: That summer, Kiritsubo Consort, the little prince's mother, felt unwell and wanted to ask leave to return to her family home to recover, but the Emperor would never permit it.

units.source_text: 这位更衣近几年来常常生病，皇上已经见惯，他说：

en.t: In recent years this consort had often been ill, and the Emperor had grown used to it, so he said:

units.source_text: “不妨暂且住在这里养养，看情形再说吧。”

en.t: "For now, stay here and rest a little. We can see how things go and decide later."

units.source_text: 但在这期间，更衣的病日重一日，只过得五六天，身体已经衰弱得厉害了。

en.t: But during that time the consort's illness grew worse day by day, and after only five or six days her body had become terribly weak.

units.source_text: 更衣的母亲太君啼啼哭哭向皇上乞假，这才准许她出宫。

en.t: Only when the consort's mother, the Lady Dowager, wept and begged the Emperor for leave did he permit her to leave the palace.

units.source_text: 即使在这等时候，也得提防发生意外、吃惊受辱。

en.t: Even at such a time, they had to guard against accidents, shocks, and humiliation.

units.source_text: 因此决计让小皇子留在宫中，更衣独自悄悄退出。

en.t: Therefore it was decided that the little prince would remain in the palace, while the consort would quietly withdraw alone.

units.source_text: 形势所迫，皇上也不便一味挽留，

en.t: Pressed by the situation, the Emperor could not simply keep insisting that she stay,

units.source_text: 只因身份关系，不能亲送出宫，心中便有难言之痛。

en.t: yet because of his position, he could not personally see her out of the palace, and this caused him a pain too deep for words.

units.source_text: 更衣本来是个花容月貌的美人儿，

en.t: The consort had originally been a woman of flowerlike beauty and moonlike grace,

units.source_text: 但这时候已经芳容消减，心中百感交集，却无力申述，看看只剩得奄奄一息了。

en.t: but by now her lovely face had faded; countless feelings filled her heart, yet she had no strength to express them, and she seemed almost at her last breath.

units.source_text: 皇上睹此情状，茫然失措，一面啼哭，一面历叙前情，重申盟誓。

en.t: Seeing her in this state, the Emperor was stunned and helpless; as he wept, he recounted their past together and repeated his vows.

units.source_text: 可是更衣已经不能答话，两眼失神，四肢瘫痪，只是昏昏沉沉地躺着。

en.t: But the consort could no longer answer; her eyes were vacant, her limbs were powerless, and she lay there in a stupor.

units.source_text: 皇上狼狈之极，束手无策，只得匆匆出室，命左右准备辇车，

en.t: The Emperor was utterly distraught and at a loss, so he hurried out of the room and ordered his attendants to prepare a carriage,

units.source_text: 但终觉舍不得她，再走进更衣室中来，又不准许她出宫了。

en.t: but in the end he could not bear to part from her; he went back into the consort's room and once again refused to let her leave the palace.

units.source_text: “我和你立下盟誓：大限到时，也得双双同行。想来你不会舍我而去吧！”

en.t: "You and I made a vow: when the end comes, we must go together. Surely you will not abandon me and leave!"

units.source_text: 那女的也深感隆情，断断续续地吟道：

en.t: She too was deeply moved by his great affection, and in broken phrases she chanted:
